expired_order_placed_at_top_of_book.meaning: an order was placed at the top of the book and is small and soon-to-expire

expired_order_remains_in_price_tree.meaning: after expiration the order remains present in the price tree
expired_order_remains_in_price_tree.checkpoint: after expiration, before new post-only submission

new_post_only_at_same_or_better_price.meaning: a new post-only order is submitted at the same or better price than the expired order

would_match_non_expired_order.meaning: the new post-only order would actually match against a non-expired existing order (the only condition under which rejection as would-fill is permitted)

post_only_rejected_as_would_fill.meaning: the new post-only order is rejected as would-fill even though the blocking best price came from an expired order that the matching engine would skip

legitimate_strategy_functioning.meaning: the legitimate trading strategy proceeds as intended (the post-only order is not wrongly blocked)

assumptions: The expired order is the best price returned by getBestAskPrice()/getBestBidPrice() at the time of the post-only check.
The matching engine would skip the expired order, so the new post-only order would not actually match against a non-expired order.
The post-only order is a legitimate trading strategy that should function as intended when it would not actually fill.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's order is a bid or ask, so the direction of the best-price comparison is unspecified; the plan encodes the scenario at the observable admission-outcome level.
Exact numeric bound relating best price P and incoming bid price is described only as P <= bid price; no plain numeric literal is supplied, so the comparison is not encoded numerically.

limitations: Formalizes only the prevent_legitimate_trading_strategies impact; other listed impacts are out of scope for this plan.
The impact is potential; the relation encodes the conditional scenario in which the expired order blocks post-only admission, not an inevitable outcome.
Admission outcome is represented as grounded Boolean observables because the report gives no numeric fillability definition.
